name: Zaptor
biography: Storm-charged desert raptors that make excellent — if hair-raising — mounts. A rider shares the zaptor's charge, electrifying their strikes. Habitat: Desert.

features.name: Shared Charge (1/Turn)
features.description: A creature mounted on the zaptor has Resistance to Lightning damage, and when the rider hits another creature with a metal weapon, both it and the target take an extra 7 (2d6) Lightning damage as part of the attack.

features.name: Thunderous Steps (1/Turn)
features.description: When the zaptor moves 30+ feet in a straight line, it creates a burst of thunder until it stops moving. Saving Throw: DC 12 Constitution, each creature within 20 feet of the zaptor's path that isn't mounted on the zaptor. Failure: 5 (2d4) Thunder damage.

features.name: Charged Tail
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is wearing metal armour, it takes an extra 5 (2d4) Lightning damage.

features.name: Storm Kick
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Lightning damage, and the target is pushed 5 feet straight away from the zaptor.

features.name: Discharge (Recharges after Using Thunderous Steps)
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 12 Dexterity, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 10 (3d6) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.
